title: Link receive comments and vector constant still misdescribe SIID as a signer IID
description: Final correctness/documentation review: python/src/lichen/link/link_layer.py receive() still says the frame does not contain a sender hint, has a TODO to try multiple senders, and describes exhaustive lookup as the current workaround, although mandatory SIID is now a canonical signer EUI-64 used for bounded indexed lookup with exhaustive fallback. test/vectors/generate.py also retains _ORACLE_SIGNER_IID_BIT even though the surrounding spec explicitly says SIID is never an IPv6 IID. Update these source comments/names to Signer Identifier / signer EUI-64 so future maintenance does not reintroduce the IID/EUI conversion bug.
acceptance_criteria: Modified source and generator use SIID only as Signer Identifier/canonical EUI-64 terminology and accurately describe indexed plus bounded fallback lookup.
